languageHelp: Choose the language used by the panel, Tray, notifications, and setup messages.
makePetYoursHelp: Keep the character of your pet assets while choosing the level of motion and feedback.
showCompletionError: Show short completion and error notices
desktopBehaviorHelp: Choose which optional features stay active on the desktop.
shimejiBehaviorHelp: Let the pet walk, rest, and respond to the cursor at a low cadence; it pauses during work, Permission, DND, or power saving.
captureExclusion: Exclude pet from supported screenshots and recordings
captureExclusionHelp: Protects the pet window only. Windows supports system capture exclusion; macOS support is limited and some capture tools may ignore it.
captureExclusionUnavailable: This platform does not expose a supported capture-exclusion API.
fullscreenAutoHide: Hide pet during other fullscreen windows
fullscreenAutoHideHelp: Hides the pet and panel when a supported external borderless fullscreen window covers their display. macOS uses native Space behavior; Windows uses a conservative Win32 event detector. Ordinary maximized windows are not treated as fullscreen.
fullscreenAutoHideUnavailable: A native external-fullscreen detector is unavailable on this platform or runtime, so this option is disabled.
rightClickHideHelp: Right-click the pet sprite or Edge Peek handle to hide it. Permission controls and other interactive content are exempt.
miniModeHelp: Keep the pet compact; return to Normal at any time.
edgePeekHelp: After 650ms at a screen edge, replace the pet with a dedicated handle.
dndHelp: Mute notifications, sounds, and extra motion.
notificationsHelp: Show native waiting and completion notifications.
permissionBubbleHelp: Show Allow once / Deny requests; hidden requests remain pending.
presentationMcpHelp: Allow local MCP clients to send short reactions and speech text only.
moodVisualsHelp: Keep mood tracking while hiding glow and color changes.
growthDataUnavailable: Growth data is unavailable until local storage is ready.
achievementsEnableHelp: Track milestones and show unlock feedback; turning this off stops new unlocks.
achievementNightOwlHelp: Complete a session between 00:00 and 05:00 local time.
achievementOneMillionHelp: Observe 1M tokens in total; the data quality is shown.
achievementPolyglotAgentsHelp: Complete work with three different Agent Adapters.
achievementBusyDayHelp: Complete 20 sessions on one local day.
achievementLoyalCompanionHelp: Use Agent Pets for seven consecutive days.
keepControlHelp: Keep setup, restart, and lifecycle actions separate from daily preferences.
presentationMcpSetupHelp: Choose a local project and configure Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode at once.
setupMcpForProject: Set up MCP for a project
projectMcpPanelTitle: Set up MCP for a project
projectMcpPanelHelp: Choose a project folder and manage the MCP settings written by Agent Pets.
projectMcpRemoveConfirmDetail: Only unchanged settings written by Agent Pets are removed; other MCP entries and project files stay untouched.
projectMcpSafetyNote: Settings are checked before removal; conflicts are kept unchanged.
historyHelp: Local aggregates only; prompts, tool arguments, and full project paths are never stored here.
historyTrackingExplain: Numbers come from local Codex/Claude Code session log files, deduplicated by timestamp; live sessions are counted directly from the Agent Hook report. For reference only — not an official billing figure. Clearing history resets the starting point.
historyClearConfirm:
Clear local history?

This does not reset pet XP, level, or achievements.
historyActionFailed: The action failed. Try again later.
projectPetsHelp: Bind a project to a pet; unbound projects keep using the selected pet. Only an anonymous identity is stored, never the full path.
projectPetsEnableHelp: Automatically switch pets by detected project, and track history and XP separately. When off, the selected pet is always used.
removeProjectPetConfirm: Remove “{name}”? This only deletes the locally stored project binding, not any of your files; it is added back automatically the next time an event arrives from that project.
projectPetsNoProjects: No projects recorded yet. Send a project event or add one here to begin.
projectPetsUnavailable: Project pet routing is currently unavailable
projectPetMissing: The previously bound pet is unavailable
chooseProjectPetHelp: Choose the project folder to add to Agent Pets.
historyRetention: Raw events are kept for {days} days; long-term aggregates remain.
connectedProjectsHelp: Agent Pets remembers local project registrations and checks them when this panel opens.
resultNeedsAttention: Some settings need attention; existing conflicts were not overwritten.
mcpEntryChanged: The setting changed, so it was not removed.
setupWizardHelp: Agents detected; restart a tool after installing its hook.
testReceiverTitle: Send a live event through the local receiver
adapterNote: Capabilities and health come from the running Adapter registry, not a hardcoded tool list. Test verifies that this Agent Pets instance can receive, normalize, and display a local live event; it does not launch a coding tool. Generic HTTP is always observe-only and cannot answer Permission.
permissionWarning: Content was shortened; check OpenCode before allowing.
returnToTerminal: Return to the terminal to handle it
quotaLocalLoginNote: Uses your local Codex / Claude CLI login; no account needed.
removePetConfirm: Remove “{name}”? This deletes the imported sprite files and cannot be undone.
hidePetConfirm: Hide “{name}” from the pet list? This cannot be undone from the UI, but the built-in assets are not deleted.
